title: Recommended places
lead: Places to rent sent to you in LINE, picked from what you tell us here. Some of them are ads.

on.title: You receive recommended places
on.body: Since {date}. You can stop at any time.

off.title: Recommended places are off
off.body: Nothing is sent to you. To receive places, say what you are looking for and agree to the text below.

outdated.title: The text you agreed to has changed
outdated.body: There is a new version ({version}). Nothing is sent until you read it and agree again below.

status.stopHint: One tap. Nothing more is sent from now on.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.body: Nothing more will be sent. Your preferences are no longer used and are deleted as the text below says. You can turn recommendations on again at any time.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: We send places that fit what you chose, never during quiet hours.

limits.title: How often
limits.cap: At most {count, plural, one {# sponsored message} other {# sponsored messages}} in any 7 days.
limits.quiet: Nothing during quiet hours: {start}–{end}, Bangkok time.

consent.heading: What you agree to
consent.english: This text is shown in English, as getproperty publishes it.
consent.accept: I have read this and want to receive recommended places, including ads (version {version})
consent.required: Tick the box to receive recommended places.

changed.title: The text has just changed
changed.body: Please read the new version above and tick the box again. Nothing was saved.

form.title: What you are looking for
form.lead: Leave anything empty if it does not matter to you.

areas.label: Areas
areas.hint: Up to {max} districts or stations. None means anywhere.
areas.full: You have chosen {max} areas. Remove one to add another.
areas.unavailable: The list of areas could not be loaded. Your chosen areas are kept.
areas.invalid: One of these areas is no longer listed. Remove it and save again.

budget.label: Monthly rent
budget.invalid: Enter an amount in baht, for example 8000.
budget.range: Check the amounts: the upper one cannot be below the lower one.

moveIn.label: When you want to move in
moveIn.invalid: Check the dates: the end cannot be before the start.

language.label: Language of the messages
language.hint: Messages are written in Thai or English; other languages get English for now.

quiet.label: Quiet hours
quiet.invalid: Enter both times, for example 22:00 and 07:00.

form.check: Some answers need a look. Check the fields marked above.

history.title: What was sent to you
history.empty: Nothing has been sent to you yet.
history.unavailable: What was sent to you could not be loaded right now.

entry.title: Recommended places
entry.on: On. Choose areas, budget and quiet hours.
entry.off: Off. Get places that fit what you are looking for.
entry.unknown: Choose whether to receive places that fit you.
